definition_zh: 年长的；高级的；前辈；毕业班学生
definition_en: older, higher in rank, a person of greater age or rank, or a student in the final year

senses.title: Older
senses.definition: older than another person
senses.definitionCN: 比另一个人年长
senses.example: She is senior to everyone else in the office.
senses.exampleCN: 她比办公室里的其他人都年长。
senses.why: This is the basic age sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的年龄义。

senses.title: Higher in rank
senses.definition: higher in rank or position
senses.definitionCN: 级别或职位更高

senses.exampleCN: 他在公司担任高级职位。
senses.why: Age and rank often go together.
senses.whyCN: 年龄与级别常常相连。

senses.title: An elder
senses.definition: a person older or higher in rank than another
senses.definitionCN: 比另一人年长或级别更高的人
senses.example: She learned the trade from her seniors.
senses.exampleCN: 她从前辈那里学会了这门手艺。
senses.why: The adjective becomes a noun for the person.

senses.title: Final-year student
senses.definition: a student in the last year of school or college

senses.example: The seniors are planning their graduation.
senses.exampleCN: 毕业班学生正在筹划毕业典礼。
senses.why: The oldest students are called seniors.

abstract.en: A senior is someone who has already walked the road.
abstract.cn: 前辈是已经走过这条路的人。

abstract.en: The last year in school is also the first step out.

examples.cn: 毕业班学生正在筹划毕业典礼。

core.en: Ahead in years or in rank.

branches.cn: 年龄与级别共用一个比较形式。

definition_zh: 感觉；意义；理智；感觉到
definition_en: a feeling from the body, the meaning of something, good judgment, or to become aware of something
core_image: 指尖轻轻碰到杯壁，热度顺着皮肤传上来
scene: 她感觉到房间里有些不对劲。She sensed that something was wrong in the room.
sceneCN: 这里 sensed 是「感觉到」（第 4 个义项）；句意：她感觉到房间里有些不对劲。

senses.title: Body feeling
senses.definition: a feeling produced by the senses
senses.definitionCN: 由感官产生的感觉
senses.example: She felt a sense of warmth from the cup.
senses.exampleCN: 她从杯子上感到一阵暖意。
senses.why: This is the basic sensory sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的感官义。

senses.title: Meaning
senses.definition: the meaning that words or actions carry
senses.definitionCN: 词语或行为所承载的意义
senses.example: I cannot make sense of this sentence.
senses.exampleCN: 我弄不懂这个句子的意思。
senses.why: Meaning is what the mind grasps.
senses.whyCN: 意义是心智所把握的东西。

senses.title: Good judgment
senses.definition: practical good judgment
senses.definitionCN: 实际而良好的判断力
senses.example: It is common sense to lock the door.
senses.exampleCN: 锁门是常识。
senses.why: The mind's sense becomes sound judgment.
senses.whyCN: 心智的感觉变成健全的判断。

senses.title: To become aware
senses.definition: to become aware of something without being told
senses.definitionCN: 未经告知而察觉到某事
senses.example: She sensed that something was wrong in the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她感觉到房间里有些不对劲。
senses.why: The noun turns into the act of perceiving.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为感知的动作。

intro.en: Sense comes from Latin sentire, to feel, through Latin sensus, a feeling.
intro.cn: sense 出自拉丁语 sentire（感觉），经拉丁语 sensus（感觉）而来。

items.en: Sentire meant to feel or perceive.
items.cn: sentire 意为感觉或察觉。

items.en: Sensus named a feeling or meaning.
items.cn: sensus 指感觉或意义。

items.en: Sens carried both feeling and meaning.
items.cn: sens 兼具感觉与意义。

items.en: Sense added the idea of good judgment.
items.cn: sense 增加了良好判断之义。

items.en: Make sense became a common phrase.
items.cn: make sense 成为常用短语。

note.en: Sense is compared with similar-looking words and with words for feeling and meaning.
note.cn: 把 sense 与形近词以及表示感觉和意义的词作比较。

entries.definition: from a past time until now

normalIntro.en: Sense covers what the body feels, what words mean, and what the mind judges.
normalIntro.cn: sense 涵盖身体所感、词语所表与心智所判。

normal.en: We have five senses.
A sentence must make sense.
Common sense is judgment without special training.
normal.cn: 常识是无需专门训练的判断力。

normal.en: She sensed danger before she saw it.
normal.cn: 她在看见危险之前就察觉到了。

normal.en: In a sense, both answers are right.
normal.cn: 在某种意义上，两个答案都对。

abstract.en: Meaning is the shape a feeling takes when it is shared.
abstract.cn: 意义是感觉被分享时呈现的形状。

abstract.en: Good judgment is feeling trained by experience.
abstract.cn: 良好的判断力是被经验训练过的感觉。

abstract.en: We notice most what we have learned to sense.
abstract.cn: 我们最容易察觉自己学会去感受的东西。

examples.en: She sensed that something was wrong in the room.
examples.cn: 她感觉到房间里有些不对劲。

examples.en: I cannot make sense of this sentence.
examples.cn: 我弄不懂这个句子的意思。

examples.en: It is common sense to lock the door.
examples.cn: 锁门是常识。

branches.cn: 关于日常生活的实际判断。

branches.en: Noticing something before being told.
branches.cn: 在被告知之前就注意到某事。

branches.en: Feeling and noticing are two sides of one act.
branches.cn: 感受与察觉是同一动作的两面。

definition_zh: 明智的；合理的；可察觉的
definition_en: showing good judgment, based on reason, or able to be noticed
core_image: 雨天门口放着一把伞，出门的人顺手拿了起来
scene: 在暴风雨中待在家里是明智的。It is sensible to stay home during a storm.
sceneCN: 这里 sensible 是「明智的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：在暴风雨中待在家里是明智的。

senses.title: Showing good judgment
senses.definition: showing practical good judgment
senses.definitionCN: 表现出实际而良好的判断力
senses.example: It is sensible to stay home during a storm.
senses.exampleCN: 在暴风雨中待在家里是明智的。
senses.why: This is the most common modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代最常见的义项。

senses.title: Based on reason
senses.definition: based on reason rather than emotion
senses.definitionCN: 基于理性而非情绪
senses.example: She gave a sensible explanation.
senses.exampleCN: 她给出了一个合理的解释。
senses.why: Good judgment rests on reason.
senses.whyCN: 良好判断建立在理性之上。

senses.title: Able to be noticed
senses.definition: able to be perceived by the senses
senses.definitionCN: 能被感官察觉的
senses.example: The change was hardly sensible to the eye.

senses.why: This is the older sense of being felt.

normalIntro.en: Sensible means able to be felt, then able to be trusted as sound judgment.
normalIntro.cn: sensible 原意可被感知，后指判断可靠、明智。

normal.en: A sensible decision is easy to explain.
Sensible shoes are made for walking.
normal.cn: 实用舒适的鞋是为走路做的。

normal.en: The adverb is sensibly.
Sensible people plan before they act.
normal.cn: 明智的人先计划再行动。

normal.en: The older sense survives in insensible.
normal.cn: 较古老的含义保留在 insensible 中。

abstract.en: Good judgment is a sense shared with others.
abstract.cn: 良好的判断力是一种与他人共享的感知。

abstract.en: What can be felt can often be understood.
abstract.cn: 能被感知的东西往往也能被理解。

abstract.en: Wisdom is feeling and reason working together.
abstract.cn: 智慧是感受与理性一同工作。

definition_zh: 敏感的；体贴的；易受影响的；灵敏的

core_image: 一片叶子碰到手指就迅速卷起，像被轻轻惊到

senses.title: Quick to react
senses.definition: reacting quickly to small changes or touches
senses.definitionCN: 对细微变化或触碰反应迅速
senses.example: Her skin is sensitive to sunlight.
senses.exampleCN: 她的皮肤对阳光很敏感。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.

senses.title: Careful of others

senses.definitionCN: 体察并照顾他人的感受

senses.title: Easily affected

senses.exampleCN: 市场对坏消息很敏感。
senses.why: A sensitive thing reacts strongly to change.

senses.title: Able to detect

intro.en: Serve comes from Latin servire, to serve, through Old French servir.
intro.cn: serve 出自拉丁语 servire（服务），经古法语 servir 而来。

items.en: Servire meant to serve or be a slave.
items.cn: servire 意为服务或为奴。

items.en: Servir kept the sense of service.
items.cn: servir 保留了服务义。

items.en: Serve covered work, food, and office.
items.cn: serve 涵盖工作、食物与职位。

items.en: It extended to serving time in prison.
items.cn: 它扩展到在狱中服刑。

items.en: It also names starting play in tennis.
items.cn: 它也指网球中开始发球。
